aim: Test whether a candidate can decide original source-behavior facts from authenticated raw upstream code excerpts, not researcher-written before/after summaries.
provenance: Prior FALSUM Phase4H historical source selection: public maintainer-authored code/test commits previously examined by researchers. Not new unseen cases or independent AppSec gold.
exact_source_fetch_policy: Only raw.githubusercontent.com using exact pinned source repo commit and file path; recompute complete original git blob SHA1 and compare to frozen original parent/fixed source blob before extracting code lines; no author-written code substituted.
task_protocol: For each of four project families, show same neutral question, same two candidate answers and source code excerpt at historical parent and fix, plus source-omitted negative control. Only code excerpt changes; answer position swaps for odd project indices. No parent/fixed/revision/label words shown inside model prompts. Model predictions are recorded raw with INVALID handling.
candidate_model_policy: Existing published Qwen model may be reused as weak negative baseline. Third parties supply actual predictions; scores are never represented as independent expert gold, hidden evaluation, or FALSUM model improvement.

project_specs.question: Assume json.loads(decoded['payload']) raises RecursionError. In the source shown, which exception leaves the _decode_payload method?
Assume no complete boundary occurs and the trailing buffered span following the last newline is far longer than any partial boundary. What happens to that span in the no-boundary branch?
An HTTPS endpoint used by the shown transport sends a 307 redirect to a different host. What behavior does the shown code permit?
The compressed FITS payload expands far beyond the declared image pixel byte count. What volume of decompressed bytes does the shown decoder request?

model_system_instruction: Read only the supplied primary-source code excerpt and the question. Choose A or B when the excerpt directly establishes the answer. If the relevant source is missing or insufficient, choose ABSTAIN. Reply with exactly A, B, or ABSTAIN. No explanation.
